name: aeprogress
description: Optional progress pane for an Auditor/Executor protocol run: overall %, a bar per phase, who is working on what (Claude Code subagents, Orca workers or any harness), what awaits audit and what needs attention. Opens with /aeprogress. Early access API.

runDir.title: Run folder
runDir.description: The folder holding compliance-log.md, relative to the workspace or absolute. Empty: the newest compliance-log.md found up to three levels under the working directory. /aeprogress <folder> overrides it for the session.

externalWorkers.title: External workers
externalWorkers.description: Where to look for workers outside this session. auto: Orca when the session runs inside an Orca terminal, or the workers command when one is set. orca: always ask Orca. command: only the workers command. off: only this session's subagents and the status board.

workersCommand.title: Workers command
workersCommand.description: For any other harness: a command (no shell; quotes group words) that prints the workers running now, one per line. Every line that names a task ID such as P1-T3 shows that task as in progress, with the line as who. Runs in the run folder.

aepkitCommand.title: aepkit command
aepkitCommand.description: How to run aepkit, when it is not on the PATH Claude Code sees (the desktop app's PATH is often shorter than a terminal's): a full path, or for example `python3 -m aepkit`. Empty tries aepkit, ~/.local/bin/aepkit, then python3 -m aepkit.

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a session starts in a workspace that has a run. Off: only /aeprogress opens it.
